bounds.kind: computed from the observed counts, assuming that the trials counted are independent and share one probability
bounds.definition: upper bound for x events in n trials: the p with P(X <= x | n, p) = alpha, the largest probability that the count does not reject at level alpha; for x = 0 this is 1 - alpha^(1/n)

D.upper_bound: none below 1: no pair starts at this label
none below 1: no pair starts at this label

per_artifact_over_the_record.note: the extreme of dependence over time: an artifact's label is one assessment kept through the record, so each artifact is one trial; of the artifacts that ever held a label, how many left it during the record. The bound is on the chance that an artifact leaves the label at some point of the record

D.upper_bound: none below 1: no artifact held this label

one_trial_per_run.note: the extreme of dependence between artifacts: the labels of a run change together or not at all, so each step between two feeder runs is one trial; the chance that a given pair changes is then bounded by this value instead of the bound of any_label_change.between_feeder_runs

smoothing.kind: computed from the observed counts under an analysis choice (the pseudo-count and the labels it is spread over)
smoothing.formula: smoothed p(a>b) = (n_ab + pseudo) / (n_a + pseudo * number of labels)

belief_seed_table.kind: observed seed table; the comparison is computed under a stated assumption
belief_seed_table.machine_note: Beliefs must traverse the evidential gradient: U->P->T or U->D->F. Direct jumps from Unknown to verified are forbidden. T<->F must pass through C or U.
belief_seed_table.file_description: Governance state machine transition weights — seed data for memristive-markov engine
belief_seed_table.assumption: one step of the table = one consecutive-row pair; the repository does not say how long a step is

stored_governance_model.kind: observed files; the consequences are computed by reading the stored matrix as a Markov chain
stored_governance_model.description: Initial uniform transition matrix for governance Markov model
stored_governance_model.note: Uniform prior — no observations yet. The MemristiveEngine VLMM will learn actual transition probabilities as governance cycles are observed. This file is the human-readable snapshot; the engine's internal state is in engine-state.json.

specification.alert_rule: When P(Freeze) > 0.3, an alert is emitted with the top recommended intervention.
specification.uniform_initialisation: P(j | i) = 0.25 for all i, j in {Healthy, Watch, Warning, Freeze}

what_observations_would_do.note: event-free observed cycles treated as independent trials. A bound on one row needs cycles that start in that row's state; the stored matrix gives the target the same probability from every state, so any run of consecutive cycles without the target counts against it

sticky_alternative.kind: synthetic: an imaginary matrix, not an estimate
sticky_alternative.note: Synthetic. An imaginary matrix over the stored model's states that keeps each state with the probability below and spreads the rest evenly over the other states. It has the same stationary distribution as the stored uniform matrix and is not an estimate of anything.

negative_controls.file_presence_test: the test that finds no engine-state.json finds transition-matrix.json in the same listing

transfer_task.note: Hypothetical weekly status log of a fleet of services, for the learner task. Not Streeling data and not a forecast.
